# Dock header actions carry tooltips that follow their toggles

## Context

Demo prep for 2026-09-03 (operator-observed, 2026-09-02): the engine header actions on every DockLayouts tabs node are icon-only buttons with no tooltip, so a pointer user gets no name for a glyph — and the demo walks through lock, reload, unpin, pop-out, maximize and close on real panes. Filed as one of the dock-polish leaves of Epic #13158 (sibling today: #18070, reveal-preview geometry).

## The Problem

`src/dashboard/dock/projection/LayoutAdapter.mjs:1103-1180` projects the six engine actions; none carries a `tooltip`. Accessible names are uneven: lock and pin set `aria-label` explicitly (`lock`/`unlock`, `unpin`), the reveal overlay's pin control says `Pin` (`src/dashboard/dock/interaction/RevealOverlay.mjs:160`), while reload, pop-out, maximize and close fall back to the name `toolbar.Base#createActionItemConfig` derives from the action key (`reload`, `pop out`, `maximize`, `close`). One of them drifts: `Workspace#syncDockMaximizeActionIcon` (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2858-2863`) swaps the glyph to `dockMinimizeIconCls` on maximize but leaves `aria-label: maximize` in place, so the restore glyph is announced as "maximize". Lock already flips icon and label together in `syncDockLockAction` (`Workspace.mjs:1466-1500`) — the pattern the rest should follow.

## The Architectural Reality

- `component.Base#tooltip_` (`src/component/Base.mjs:286-296`): a string or config; without `ownInstance` the component joins the per-app shared tooltip singleton (`neo-uses-shared-tooltip`), which copies `target._tooltip` on hover (`tooltip.Base.applySingletonTargetConfig`, showDelay 200 ms). The config is reactive — `afterSetTooltip` rebuilds on change — so a text set on the retained instance is live for the next hover. `createActionItemConfig` spreads the action config onto the button, so a `tooltip` key on an action config reaches the instance untouched.
- Engine action chrome is projected from the workspace context (`Workspace.mjs:3262-3290` carries `dockLockIconCls`, `dockMaximizeIconCls`, `dockPopOutIconCls` …) — the seam a tooltip text travels through, and the precedent for consumer-overridable engine chrome.
- Per-item runtime state rides the ONE retained action instance (`syncDock*Action`; the stable-instance rule the adapter documents at `LayoutAdapter.mjs:1120-1127`). A tooltip that follows a toggle is set on that instance, never by re-projecting the actions array.
- The reveal overlay's pin control is its own `TabHeaderToolbar` action (`RevealOverlay.mjs:150-160`), bound by `Rail#bindRevealOverlay`; it needs the same text by the same discipline.
- A withdrawn action has no DOM node (#18042, PR #18069), so it has no tooltip target — the focus gate is untouched by this work.

## The Fix

1. **One consumer-overridable map on `Workspace`:** `dockActionTooltips`, engine defaults keyed by action state — `lock`, `unlock`, `reload`, `unpin`, `popOut`, `maximize`, `restore`, `close`, `revealPin` — beside the icon configs (`Workspace.mjs:147-230`). A consumer changes wording or language in one place; a missing key means no tooltip for that action, never a broken button.
2. **Projection:** the adapter reads the map from the context and stamps `tooltip` on each engine action config, choosing `lock`/`unlock` the way it chooses the icon.
3. **Toggles on the retained instance:** `syncDockLockAction` adds `tooltip` to its batched changes; the maximize sync flips icon, `aria-label` and tooltip together (`maximize` ↔ `restore`), closing the announced-name drift.
4. **Reveal overlay:** the overlay gains a tooltip config for its pin control, fed from the map at the seam where the workspace instantiates the overlay.
5. JSDoc on the map and both syncs; the styling-guide slot stays with #18036.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / refusal | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Workspace#dockActionTooltips` (new config) | precedent `dockLockIconCls` / `dockMaximizeIconCls` (`Workspace.mjs:147-230`) | one map, engine defaults, per-key consumer override | absent key → whatever the projection stamped; an explicit `null` → no tooltip for that action, and on a toggle it clears the tooltip in the state that key names while the other half restores its own | Workspace JSDoc | unit: the projected action carries the override |
| engine header actions (`LayoutAdapter.mjs:1103-1180`) | #18014 default action rail | each carries `tooltip` from the map; lock/unlock chosen with the icon | n/a | adapter JSDoc | component: hover reads the shared tooltip's text |
| `Workspace#syncDockLockAction`, the maximize sync | #17949 lock, #13158 maximize | tooltip flips with icon and `aria-label` on the retained instance; maximize gains the label flip | unchanged when the key is absent | JSDoc | unit arms per toggle |
| reveal overlay pin control (`RevealOverlay.mjs:150-160`) | #13280 reveal / pin | tooltip from the map's `revealPin` | unchanged | JSDoc | component: hover on the overlay's pin |

**Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029** — presentation on the retained action instances; no model, operation or wire change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each engine header action (lock, reload, pin, pop-out, maximize, close) and the reveal overlay's pin control shows an engine tooltip on hover whose text names the action; a component witness hovers each on a revealed rail and reads the shared tooltip's text.
- [ ] Lock ↔ unlock and maximize ↔ restore flip tooltip, icon and `aria-label` together on the retained instance (no actions-array rebuild); the maximize action reads `aria-label: restore` while the restore glyph shows.
- [ ] The texts live in one `Workspace` config map with engine defaults; a consumer override reaches the projected action, and an absent key yields no tooltip rather than an error.
- [ ] Focus gating is unchanged: a withdrawn action has no node and no tooltip; a revealed one keeps its tooltip.
- [ ] The existing dock witnesses (DockLock, DockMaximize, DockPopOut, DockReload) and the tab header unit suite stay green.

## Out of Scope

- Tooltips on consumer `hostActions` (consumer-owned) and on the rail's strip tabs (their titles are visible text).
- Tooltip theming, geometry and delays (`tooltip.Base` owns them).
- An i18n mechanism beyond the map.

## Avoided Traps

- **Native `title` attributes:** the browser tooltip ignores the theme and its own delays, and `title` beside `aria-label` double-announces in some assistive tech; the engine tooltip is the one already themed and delegated.
- **Re-projecting the actions array to change text** breaks the stable-instance contract every `syncDock*Action` relies on.
- **Nine `dockXTooltip` configs:** one map is one knob; the icon configs stay as they are because they predate the map.
